tasks.title: Build isolated shared-auth provisioning API and invitation lifecycle
acceptance: Implement a private, versioned service API called only by the VMMS account worker; validate a short-lived token against the exact issuer, audience, client and single provisioning permission.

Require recipient email verification and password enrollment; set the action link expiry to 24 hours and permit no more than one resend without extending expiry.

Run staging checks only with synthetic .test users and locally captured non-delivery mail; do not access production identity, send real email, deploy or create real users.
